window-1.title: Koalas to the Max
window-1.blurb: Drag to split one big dot into thousands until a hidden picture emerges — and then feed it your own image so your friends have to slowly unpick a photo of your grandma, dot by dot.

window-2.title: Forget AI. 2026 Is the Year of the Fashion Illustrator
window-2.blurb: Everyone's outsourcing images to a machine and meanwhile the girls with markers are quietly winning — this is your permission slip to draw the whole lookbook by hand.

window-3.title: Non-Alcoholic Espresso Stout Martini
window-3.blurb: A zero-proof espresso martini crossed with a stout — dark, foamy, absurdly photogenic in a coupe, and exactly the kind of committed-to-the-bit drink you'd hand someone at 10pm just to watch their face.

window-4.title: Apartamento × LOEWE: Carlota Guerrero at Home, shot by Coco Capitán
window-4.blurb: Three women artists photographed inside their own homes by Coco Capitán — rooms styled like self-portraits, which is basically your whole thesis on living, so go build yourself a corner that photographs like a story about you.

window-5.title: Takara House, Haji Lane
window-5.blurb: A blue-fronted vintage shop with a tiny patisserie hiding up the stairs — you'd go for the tart, stay two hours digging through the trinkets, and leave with three new project ideas and a roll of photobooth strips.
